channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: US treated Pakistan worse than toilet paper, says Khawaja Asif
item.description: Pakistan’s Defence Minister Khawaja Asif has made a striking admission regarding the country’s historical alignment with the United States, accusing Washington of exploiting Islamabad for its strategic interests before abandoning it once its objectives were achieved.

item.title: Construction work of Babri Mosque in Murshidabad’s Beldanga to begin today
item.description: The construction work for the Babri Mosque at Beldanga in minority-dominated Murshidabad district of West Bengal, masterminded by the maverick and now-suspended Trinamool Congress legislator, Humayun Kabir, will start from Wednesday.

item.title: ‘Mamma’ Parineeti Chopra stuns in pink saree as she steps out for 2 hours
item.description: Actress and new mother Parineeti Chopra turned heads as she stepped out in a stunning pink saree, quipping that if “Mamma” has to leave the house for two hours, it better be in style.

item.title: AAP MP in Rajya Sabha pushes for ‘Right to Recall’ of elected public representatives
item.description: Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) Rajya Sabha member Raghav Chadha has strongly advocated for the introduction of a "Right to Recall" mechanism in India, allowing voters to remove non-performing elected representatives such as MPs and MLAs before the end of their term.

item.title: Delhi High Court issues notice over PIL on missing persons in national capital
item.description: The Delhi High Court on Wednesday issued notice to Delhi Police on a public interest litigation (PIL) concerning cases of missing persons in the national capital.

item.title: Patna civil court receives sixth bomb threat; premises evacuated, security tightened
item.description: The Patna Civil Court received yet another bomb threat on Wednesday morning, triggering panic and leading to the evacuation of the entire court premises.

item.title: T20 WC: Numbers game from Pakistan vs USA Group A match
item.description: After Pakistan secured a convincing 32-run victory over the USA in their Group A clash of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup at the Sinhalese Sports Club in Colombo, have alook at the numbers game from the contest.

item.title: Telangana Municipal polls: CM Revanth Reddy, Deputy CM cast votes
item.description: Telangana Chief Minster A. Revanth Reddy and Deputy Chief Minister Mallu Bhatti Vikramarka cast their votes for the municipal elections on Wednesday.

item.title: Experts hail revised AI deepfake guidelines that focus on misleading content
item.description: Legal experts have welcomed the government’s amended guidelines on AI-generated deepfakes, saying that social media intermediaries will be happy with the reasonable efforts expectation rather than the earlier proposed visible labelling.

item.title: Pakistan: Polio teams targetted by parents in Lahore
item.description: Two polio teams were attacked in different areas of Pakistan's Lahore as parents did not allow them to administer polio drops to their children, local media reported on Tuesday.
